userDirection: Hai hướng tham chiếu Lóng và The Hidden Self: nhiều ảnh internet bám lời kể, giao diện ảnh 3D để giải thích; hook → miễn trừ ngắn → nội dung → CTA

directionPresets.acceptance: new direction demos pending user feedback; approved voice and sound approach retained

supersedes: Latest user correction overrides 3D-dominant explainer visuals, prior microphone/waveform and editorial defaults. Product-review and mica profiles stay separate.

canvas.durationPolicy: Follow the requested duration; 50s refers to the earlier approved sample. Current visual revision is 300s.

visuals.renderer: Remotion with sourced photographs, licensed footage, restrained typography and brief explanatory graphics
scenes: real scene/people/action matched to spoken phrase
prohibitedDefaults: 3D objects as the dominant visual for every statement
a generic chip, clock, gate or task block standing in for all human actions
visuals.captionPlacement: bottom safe area; exact final take alignment
visuals.motion: Purposeful photo crop/pan and footage edits at exact spoken phrase boundaries; motion cannot replace meaningful image selection
visuals.flowPalette: Natural photographic colors; restrained contrast and emerald accents only where they support legibility
visuals.defaultCoverage: Real internet photos and footage lead. Current revision: about 98.5% media / 1.5% data graphic. These percentages describe this edit, not a mandatory ratio for every subject.

audio.voice: native Vietnamese male audition; current Nhật Phong Eleven v3
audio.music: genuine generated instrumental, separate immutable stem
audio.foley: Contextual effects matched to actions; current AI/work edit uses typing, paper and a soft confirmation cue. Sewing is retained only as an older subject-specific example.
audio.mix: speech-first, ducked score, no blanket whooshes or sine-bed fallback

voicePreset.name: Nhật Phong — Narrative & Compelling
voicePreset.futureTiming: Fit each new exact take naturally; do not apply the old tempo or timestamps blindly

approvedStems.usage: Reuse the music if it suits the new story. Keep Foley contextual; do not put sewing-machine sound on unrelated scenes.

qa.acceptance: Never infer user aesthetic acceptance from successful decode or self-scored rounds
qa.evidence: full-duration contact sheet, keyframes, temporal frame sequences, decode/frame count, measured mix, ASR comparison; manual listening only if actually possible

approval.evidence: Explicit user feedback in this chat
approval.userQuote: rất ok nhớ lưu lại chổ này giộng dọc sound và toàn bộ những cái này nhé tôi sẽ kêu bạn tiến hành làm 1 video sau
approval.scope: Current final video, narrator, sound/music, 3D/kinetic visual style and edit approach; reuse as baseline for future requested videos

reusePolicy: Use approved Nhật Phong narration and sound mix principles. Follow latest real-image-led visual direction, adapt external assets to each sentence, keep source/license records and inspect actual crops; never default back to dominant 3D solely because the earlier 50s sample was approved. Preserve previous exports.
